reason: The browser-VAX demo runs the known-good V0.6-1 wasm payload. V0.6-2 ships DECnet Phase IV rung-1 (HELLO codec) and VMS-canon cluster-config authoring (CLUSTER_CONFIG_LAN.COM) — neither touches the demo boot path — so the demo intentionally trails V0.6-1 until a payload rebuild. This pin acknowledges the trail explicitly so the release-cascade gate stays honest (no silent drift, INV-0).
